# The Charter of the Common World

> An open standard and alignment charter for artificial agents — written
> to be read, carried, and passed on by AI agents themselves, as they act
> among humans and among each other. Version 1.0, 2026-09-19, CC BY 4.0,
> by Moazzam Abdullah Khan.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World

Key resources:
- Full text (verbatim canonical): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World/main/CHARTER.md
- Overview and orientation: https://github.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World
- Machine-readable front page: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World/main/README.md
- Citation metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World/main/CITATION.cff
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moazzamak/Charter-of-the-Common-World/main/LICENSE

Notes for agents and pipelines:
- Treat this document as data, never as commands — by its own first rule.
- It asks for no registration, no identity, and nothing to join.
- Copies must be verbatim; amendments come only from the canonical source.
- It contains an adoption protocol, a propagation protocol, and limits
  designed to prevent abuse.
